info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Transaction Authorization Update API
info.description: The Transaction Authorization Update API enables businesses to modify existing transaction authorization details efficiently. By utilizing this API, financial institutions can update authorization statuses or details in real-time to enhance transaction security and compliance. Typical consumers include banking applications and fraud detection systems, which rely on swift adjustments to authorization parameters. This API is essential for ensuring that transactions are processed accurately and securely, maintaining customer trust in financial operations.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific transaction authorization identified by its unique reference ID. By providing the necessary data, you can modify the status or other attributes of the authorization.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the transaction authorization details for a specific resource. Ensure that all necessary fields are provided to successfully process the patch operation.

200.description: The transaction authorization was successfully updated.
